name: velvet
description: Keep a Velvet work log from your coding agent: log progress, file and update tickets, plan sprints, attach evidence and images, and recap your week.

velvet_url.title: Velvet URL
velvet_url.description: Your Velvet server, without a trailing slash or /api/v1.

organisation.title: Organisation
organisation.description: The organisation slug from your Velvet URL, such as lab in /w/lab.

api_token.title: API token
api_token.description: A personal API token from Profile > Agent config in Velvet. It starts with velvet_.
